title: PAGODA 50-NIGHT — Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
claims: PAGODA 50-NIGHT is listed as 57 km with 3,600 m of elevation gain, starting on Saturday 28 November 2026 at 18:00 from Doi Inthanon National Park HQ, with a maximum allowed race time of 16 hours 30 minutes.
The NIGHT race carries 4 Running Stones and uses the same PAGODA 50 loop through Doi Hua Suea, Doi Pha Tang Peak and the Twin Royal Pagodas.
The 2026 edition introduces the night race as a new format that reaches the twin pagodas at dawn.
